inputs.doc: Remote dir path from root for WRF Download

properties.description: Solving Dijkstra's optimization algorithm to find optimal ship routes that minimize CO2 emissions, trip time and distance. Using VISIR II software (https://zenodo.org/records/10960842 created by CMCC), that runs using forcing from either CMRL's (https://crl.iacm.forth.gr/en/) high resolution models in the southern Greece region forecasting atmospheric state (WRF 3km x 3km), hydrodynamics (NEMO 1km x 1km) and waves (Wavewatch III 1km x 1km), or the GFS/CMEMS lower resolution forecasts to be able to generalize to routes globally.
properties.name: Execution of VISIR model
